## 2. Quality vocabulary, readiness and evidence

- **status_precedence**:
  - missing_input
  - insufficient_history
  - incomplete_coverage
  - not_applicable
  - available
- **reasons**:
  - absent_input
  - future_knowledge
  - governed_gap
  - insufficient_history
  - no_eligible_observations
  - null_field
  - observed_empty
  - unknown_availability
  - zero_denominator
- **reason_order**: enum string order, no duplicates
- **rule**: inherited unchanged from docs/api/INTRADAY.md quality table; the only addition is that a complete operand whose divisor is mathematically zero publishes not_applicable/zero_denominator with full expected/observed counts
- **expected**:
  - **anchored (macd, dmi)**: max(seed, epoch_slots)
  - **rolling (stochastic)**: seed (the window span)
  - **absent delivery**: same expected, observed 0
- **observed**: dependency slots whose required fields, coverage and knowledge all qualify
- **dependency_fields**:
  - **macd_***: close on every epoch slot
  - **dmi_***: close, high, low on epoch slots a..t-1; high, low on the target (if t>a); if t=a only the anchor slot (close, high, low)
  - **stoch_d**: high, low on the last k+s+d-2 epoch slots; close on the last s+d-1 of them
  - **stoch_k**: high, low on the last k+s-1 epoch slots; close on the last s
  - **williams_r**: high, low on the last k epoch slots; close on the last one
- **evidence**: R17 rules: actually supplied consumed or knowledge-excluded dependency rows, row_id slot:<global_index>, boundary completed_interval, sorted feature id then slot, truncated to the result-wide evidence_limit
- **evidence_rule**: missing_input outputs have empty evidence rows; evidence lists only consumed rows or knowledge-excluded rows of dependency slots actually supplied
